manual_source: 993 Repair Manual (Porsche AG, 2001 printing), OCR pass 2026-08-28
rule: The manual describes the stock 993 engine. The scanned part is an aftermarket 935-type head, so no manual value calibrates it. The comparison shows only whether the scan's assumed scale (1 unit = 1 mm) is contradicted by sizes the two heads are likely to share. Manual values are OCR transcriptions and carry the status given in the manual record.
verdict: not contradicted: the two seat diameters fall on the two manual valve sizes within about 1.5%, and one seat angle matches. This supports the scale as an indication and suggests valve_y_minus is the inlet. It is not a calibration and it identifies no dimension of the specimen.

comparisons.reading: the seat contact circle is a little smaller than the valve head; the two agree within 0.1%
